sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: Your intake answers, screening results, referrals and consent choices. Contact details are collected only if you book, and answers are encrypted.

sections.heading: Your consent controls everything
sections.body: Nothing is stored, shared, used for reminders or analysed without the matching consent, which you can grant or revoke at any time. Revocation takes effect immediately.

sections.heading: Who can see your data
sections.body: Only you, unless you share a record with a clinician for a limited time. Every clinician read is logged and visible to you.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can export everything we hold about you, and you can delete your personal data at any time from this app.

sections.heading: Prototype honesty
sections.body: This prototype uses synthetic data only and is not clinically validated. It makes no compliance claims.
